correctness.rationale: The cases i<j, i=j, and i>j follow by exact conditioning under the uniform permutation law. For i<j, position j is exchangeable among the remaining j-1 prefix positions and their maximum necessarily exceeds the fixed value; for i=j, the preceding value set must be exactly {1,...,j-1}; for i>j, record symmetry is unchanged. Summation gives the aggregate law, and standard marginal variances give the correlation. The packaged checker exhaustively verifies the formulas through n=9.
